instruction: Candid cinematic still, medium shot. On a sandy beach with a rocky shoreline under an overcast sky, a young couple walks together. On the left, the woman in the peach crop top and light blue jeans (R1) walks forward with a gentle smile, her dark hair blowing in the wind. Beside her on the right, the man in the blue t-shirt and olive shorts (R2) walks with a warm smile, wearing a striped headband. They walk side-by-side, holding hands, with the man positioned slightly behind the woman. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused daylight, creating a muted, warm color palette with low contrast and a soft-focus background.
